correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Gamma(n+d,1) monomial radial measure and by-parts difference identity Gamma(n+d+1)(lambda_{n+1}-lambda_n)=sum(e^-a_j a_j^(n+d)-e^-b_j b_j^(n+d)). Ordered endpoint signs alternate (+,-) q times; exponential Chebyshev/Descartes Rolle induction bounds real zeros by 2q-1 and hence maxima by q, interior minima by q-1 even with sampled zeros and endpoint n=0. For fixed p, first low-radius interval is tuned by Gamma(d,1) CDF; far shells [R_j-sqrt(R_j),R_j+sqrt(R_j)] with R_j=M^(2j) induce strict crossings at x=R_j-1 and R_j using logarithmic mean R_j-1/3+O(R_j^-1). Stirling large-deviation separation makes other shells negligible. Independently sampled q=2 peaks d=1 at indices 0,99 and d=2 at 0,98 for shells [0.1,1.2],[90,110].
residual_risks: Far-shell construction is asymptotic M->infinity; finite checks do not exhaust all p,d,q. The exact variation bound uses standard exponential-sum Rolle theorem.
